scope: Native separate backpack on Offhand with Escape during trainer gossip, ordinary player inspection and early-shown Inspect
cases: Real Ironforge Shaman trainer gossip closed before the target cleared. The native separate backpack stayed at its Offhand bounds.
Native Inspect returned equipment in the left panel slot. The first Escape dismissed Inspect and the second cleared the player target while the backpack stayed visible.

Early-shown Inspect returned equipment outside the native slots. With Inspect absent from the special-window list, the first Escape closed Inspect and the second cleared the target while the backpack stayed visible.
With no target or interaction window, Escape opened the Game Menu.
integration_note: Tested on Noggaholic with Baganator and MoveMyBags temporarily unloaded. BugGrabber session 1136 reported zero stored gameplay UI errors. A separate BugSack diagnostic command failed. No current-session taint log was available.
